plan.title: Ctrl-K search: add a toggle for newest-first conversation ordering
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: PAN-3703 makes Ctrl-K conversation results appear newest first. Once that lands the ordering is unconditional; operators who preferred relevance-ranked order have no way back. The newest-first ordering must become optional through a visible, persistent, accessible toggle inside the palette.
narratives.Proposal: Implement the toggle entirely client-side in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandPalette.tsx. The server response already carries ts and rank per conversation hit, so no API change is needed. Add an overdeck.ui.* localStorage preference (default ON), carry ts onto PaletteAction as sortTs, add an exported newest-first comparator (ts desc, missing-ts last, rank-asc tiebreak), gate the Conversations group's within-group sort on the preference, and render a native <button aria-pressed> labeled 'Newest first' in the palette footer with scope-chip styling. If PAN-3703 lands first, gate its ordering behind this preference instead of adding a duplicate comparator; if it ordered server-side, still add the client comparator so OFF restores rank order without a refetch.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server-side ordering change, new query parameter, or API-contract change.
- No reordering of non-conversation groups, and no per-group toggles.
- No cross-device or account sync of the preference (localStorage only).
- No change to which conversations are searched or matched — display order only.
- No grouping/dedup of multiple hits from one conversation.
- Not a fix for PAN-3703 itself; this issue owns the toggle and shares the comparator contract.

autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3703 establishes newest-first as the requested behavior; the issue asks to make it optional, not to revert the default.
The client already receives ts and rank per hit; only a client-side design can restore rank order without a refetch or new query parameter.
The established Command-Palette-adjacent settings pattern (Sidebar.tsx overdeck.ui.* keys, lazy useState + try/catch write-through); the issue explicitly asks for the established pattern.
aria-pressed on a native button is the existing dashboard toggle idiom (PipelineView.tsx) and satisfies keyboard + screen-reader accessibility with no new component or color tokens.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan is executable regardless of PAN-3703 landing order
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3703 is still in planning with no merged code; the PRD fully specifies the comparator and defines both coordination paths so the work agent never has to wait or guess.
